products.label: PDS Rings Node Jupiter ring table
products.process: Choose a ring in proportion to its opacity, 1 - exp(-tau), times its width times its radius; place a dot between its boundaries and within its vertical thickness about Jupiter's ring plane; repeat 600 times. The dot's longitude, radius and height come from a seeded generator.
limitations: No ring particle has a measured position. Only each ring's share of the dots, its boundaries and its thickness are measured; each dot's place is drawn from a seeded generator.
Jupiter's rings are invisible at their true opacity; the 600 dots are a display choice. At the density of Saturn's dots Jupiter would have none.
The dots are spread evenly through each ring's thickness, which is an assumption: the table gives only the total thickness.
